company.name: Nav
company.shortDescription: Nav is a credit and financial health platform that provides access to credit and financing opportunities for businesses.
company.description: Nav Technologies provides financial management tools that help small businesses access credit and financing opportunities. The company offers a platform where users can monitor and understand their business credit profiles, match with financing options, and receive insights to improve creditworthiness. Nav Technologies integrates with bank accounts, accounting software, and credit bureaus to offer tailored recommendations based on a business’s financial data. The platform allows businesses to compare credit cards, loans, and other financial products suited to their needs. Nav also offers identity protection features, alerts for changes in credit reports, and educational content to support informed financial decisions. The company aims to streamline how small businesses manage credit and find funding options through data-driven tools and transparency.
